description: This file contains Dart classes modeling shopping cart data structures, including Cart and CartItem, with serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item in the shopping cart, including product details and quantity.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents the entire shopping cart containing multiple CartItems and provides aggregate properties.

methods.name: CartItem.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of CartItem with optional new product and quantity.

methods.name: CartItem.toJson
methods.description: Serializes CartItem to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: CartItem.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON map into a CartItem instance.

methods.name: Cart.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of Cart with optional new list of items.

methods.name: Cart.toJson
methods.description: Serializes Cart to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: Cart.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON map into a Cart instance.
